articles.title: Vantor Archive Imagery Added to Satellite Data Explorer
articles.summary: NASA’s Commercial Satellite Data Acquisition (CSDA) Program announces the addition of imagery from Vantor to its Satellite Data Explorer (SDX) data access and discovery tool.

articles.title: CSDA Releases New Data Acquisition Request System
articles.summary: The CSDA Program’s Data Acquisition Request System lets authorized users submit proposals for yet-to-be-collected data from CSDA’s commercial partners.

articles.title: CSDA Program Announces Eight New Data Agreements
articles.summary: NASA’s Commercial Satellite Data Acquisition (CSDA) Program announced eight new agreements with seven of its commercial partners to give users more access to near‑global multispectral and synthetic aperture radar data.

articles.title: 42 Years of Measuring the Sun, the Earth and the Energy in Between
articles.summary: By Denise Lineberry On Jan. 31, 1958, Explorer 1 became the first satellite launched by the United States. Its primary science instrument, a cosmic ray detector, was designed to measure the radiation environment in Earth orbit.
